name: Massintos, Wielder of Fates

bonuses.name: Architect of Ruin
bonuses.text: The GM gains 1 point of Ruin at the start of each of Massintos turns.

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: Massintos may use Ruin actions and has 2 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Mark of Chaos
bonuses.text: Massintos has a Mark of Chaos (Undivided)

bonuses.name: Space Marine Implants
bonuses.text: Massintos gains bonus dice and options for actions from Space Marine Implants (W&G Core Rulebook p.75)

abilities.name: Gifts of the Dark Gods
abilities.text: Massintos may attempt to activate one of the following psychic powers: Smite (Wrath & Glory, page 272), any Maleficarum Discipline power (page 281).

abilities.name: Let the Galaxy Burn!
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin to activate a Psychic Power or Deny the Witch (p.267).

abilities.name: Veteran of the Long War
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. Add the game's Tier as ED to all attacks this Threat makes this Round

note: Mark of Chaos is a printed Bonus but not in the keyword line. Force Stave prints Range 2.
